list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (reported by Push Square, 18 November 2026). Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own. Guides are this entry's own words; each names its sources.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is no separate task behind it. Work the roadmap in order (story, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and clean-up) and this one follows on its own. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 at about 200 hours, and GTABase agrees on the time. No multiplayer, no DLC and no difficulty setting stand in the way.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story trophy and it cannot be missed — just play the mission through to the end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Don't worry if it doesn't appear the instant the chapter ends: GTABase notes it pops once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. GTABase notes it is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City, so a short delay is normal.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. GTABase says it arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life — keep playing and it will come.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy that cannot be missed; finish the chapter and it pops as the story moves on. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. GTABase notes free roam carries on after the credits, so everything else on this list can be cleaned up afterwards — and although there is no mission replay, no trophy depends on how you play a mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. A story trophy that unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story trophy that unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story trophy that unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy that unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story trophy that unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy that unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy on the list, by both GTABase and PowerPyx. Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story (progress made earlier still counts) and work the checklist: every robbery, underwater find, shooting-range gold, drone race and Bret Target Deck in full, plus a share of the rest — 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. PowerPyx calls it roughly 60% of true completion, not everything, and nothing on it is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Before vaults open, you can box in an armored truck, stick a bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed. (GTABase; area count per PSNProfiles.)
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress, then Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so you'll finish this one on the way. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City — that is all the description gives us. No guide has confirmed the exact steps yet, and this guide won't invent them; check back once players pin it down. (GTABase: exact steps aren't confirmed yet. OutputLag lists it among the five unconfirmed trophies.)
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom. No guide has confirmed the exact steps yet — this guide won't invent them. (GTABase: exact steps aren't confirmed yet. OutputLag lists it among the five unconfirmed trophies.)
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You don't need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia, then Strength, in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map, then Activities) with your partner along — training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Rack up 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get there without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI to watch the count climb. One warning: don't push towards the Irredeemable profile — it's permanent. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — that is the only lead anyone has. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, and this guide won't guess one. (GTABase: exact steps aren't confirmed yet. OutputLag lists it among the five unconfirmed trophies.)
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. No guide has confirmed what it is yet — this guide won't invent one. (GTABase: exact steps aren't confirmed yet. OutputLag lists it among the five unconfirmed trophies.)
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. No guide has confirmed the exact steps yet. (GTABase: exact steps aren't confirmed yet. OutputLag lists it among the five unconfirmed trophies.)
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It's a running total, so the robberies you do for 100% get you there. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest — spend there first and the trophy comes quickly. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you don't count. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts. There are 397 on offer — 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — so pick the kind you enjoy; flying under bridges is the fastest way to pile them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt isn't needed. Watch the count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and keep going to 300: the 100% checklist wants that many. (GTABase; PowerPyx counts the same 397.)
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress, then Activities shows what's left; most of these happen naturally while you play. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you're there instead of coming back. (GTABase; PowerPyx counts 14 locations and 42 races.)
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from, and winning the same race again doesn't count. Mix car races, race challenges and drone races to get there faster. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge to take the trophy. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick whichever you finish fastest. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Run all five in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the last one hands you the trophy. They stay open after the story, so there's no rush. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton — the green KR icon in Key Lento — hires you in Chapter 1 to pull treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig each one up. He vanishes after Chapter 1, then texts Jason again later, so you can finish the set then. Follow it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, once the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break is done. Work through them in order; the fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay open after the story. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie don't. Which other strands qualify is still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list as you go. None of them feed into 100%, and all of them stay open after the story. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 job that hands you the Key Cloner — Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — Randy starts his Wish List: 16 sports cars to bring to his garage in west Vice City (look for the RK icon). Check any car with the WAiNK app before you grab it; the hotel driveways by Vice Beach and Ocean Beach turn up the most matches, and a cleaner car earns you more. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone sends you after the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough of them are destroyed, his last job — Shut Down the Labs — awards the trophy. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18 — meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Follow the count under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation — it's gone after Chapter 1, and nobody has confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it, so don't skip it. (GTABase; PowerPyx flags the same Chapter 1 spot.)
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but isn't required. Which animal triggers the trophy isn't confirmed yet — the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so work them all. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you don't need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so chase the ones you're nearest to finishing. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags — just scan whatever you pass. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress, then Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you're out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well, and bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you're still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City — open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — sit close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it doesn't, rob a fourth. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you don't need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you'll get this one anyway on the way there. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first — eat, drink or wash up at home, and Adrenaline makes it last longer — and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians don't seem to count. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield don't count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks sit at the south end of the base — then take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it's open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000. (GTABase.)
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
